items.label: 真题
items.english: Though often viewed as a problem for western states, the growing frequency of wildfires is a national concern because of its impact on federal tax dollars.
items.translation: 虽然野火的频繁发生经常被视为西部各州的一个问题，但由于它对联邦税收的影响，它已经成为全国关注的问题。

items.label: 真题
items.english: Throughout the evening, one man had been particularly talkative, frequently offering ideas and anecdotes, while his wife sat silently beside him on the couch.
items.translation: 整个晚上，一位男士显得特别健谈，频繁表达自己的观点，讲述一些逸闻趣事，而他妻子则安静地坐在他旁边的沙发上。

items.label: 例
items.english: You have no right to terminate the contract.
items.translation: 你无权终止合同。

items.label: 例
items.english: I knew that I owed the surgeon my life.
items.translation: 我明白外科医生救了我的命。

items.label: 例
items.english: Don’t always rely on others to understand and sympathise.
items.translation: 不要老是指望别人的理解和同情。

items.label: 例
items.english: Airline passengers no longer have to turn off all electronic devices while on the plane.
items.translation: 飞机上的乘客不再需要关闭所有的电子设备。

items.label: 真题
items.english: The great question is who should benefit from the analysis of all the data that our lives now generate.
items.translation: 重要的问题是，谁应该从我们现今生活中产生的所有数据的分析中受益。

items.label: 例
items.english: Increased emphasis is now being placed on corporate image.
items.translation: 现在越来越强调企业形象。

items.label: 例
items.english: She had no tolerance for jokes of any kind.
items.translation: 她容不得开任何玩笑。

items.label: 真题
items.english: Mass-produced clothing, like fast food, fills a hunger and need, yet is non-durable and wasteful.
items.translation: 批量生产的服装，就像快餐一样，满足了饥饿感和需求，但却不耐用且浪费。
items.reason: 原书列在durable派生项下，实际目标non-durable含否定前缀；关联保存，不把不耐用反挂到耐用义。

items.label: 例
items.english: This was a fantastic opportunity for students.
items.translation: 这对学生来说是一个极好的机会。

items.label: 例
items.english: It’s becoming fashionable to have long hair again.
items.translation: 现在又开始流行留长发了。

items.label: 例
items.english: The rise in train fares has aroused public indignation.
items.translation: 火车票提价激起了公愤。

items.label: 真题
items.english: Everybody loves a fat pay rise. Yet pleasure at your own can vanish if you learn that a colleague has been given a bigger one. Indeed, if he has a reputation for slacking, you might even be outraged.
items.translation: 人人都喜欢大幅度加薪。然而，如果你得知某位同事得到了更大的加薪，自己的快乐就会消失。事实上，如果他有懒散的名声，你甚至可能会愤怒。

items.label: 例
items.english: The natives are noted for their hospitality.
items.translation: 当地人以好客而闻名。

items.label: 例
items.english: The course is essentially theoretical in orientation.
items.translation: 该课程的定位是以理论为主。

items.label: 真题
items.english: If the subjects quickly chose a falsely flattering image—which most did—they genuinely believed it was really how they looked.
items.translation: 如果受试者很快选择了一张比本人好看的虚假照片——大多数人都这么选了——那他们打心底相信这张照片就是他们真实的样子。

items.label: 例

items.translation: 她身体健康，容光焕发。

items.label: 真题

items.translation: 新奇的事物本身经常引起怀疑。

items.label: 例

items.translation: 整件事非常神秘。

items.label: 真题

items.translation: 不幸的是，这些评论家几乎被遗忘了。

items.label: 例

items.translation: 正在努力通过外交途径解决争端。

items.translation: 我们都对这事是如何发生的感到困惑不已。
